question_vi: Làm thế nào để test custom hooks?
question_en: How do you test custom hooks?
answer_vi: Dùng @testing-library/react với `renderHook` utility: `const { result } = renderHook(() => useMyHook()); expect(result.current.value).toBe(expected)`. Để test interactions: `act(() => { result.current.setValue('new') })`. Với async hooks dùng `waitFor`. `renderHook` tạo component test wrapper để hooks có React context đầy đủ.
answer_en: Use @testing-library/react with the `renderHook` utility: `const { result } = renderHook(() => useMyHook()); expect(result.current.value).toBe(expected)`. To test interactions: `act(() => { result.current.setValue('new') })`. For async hooks use `waitFor`. `renderHook` creates a test component wrapper so hooks have full React context.
